summary: Draft-only candidate: photo-path forgery, retry, inactive access and review evidence hardened in source. Real Storage, private verifier, deployment and physical mobile QA remain release blockers.

findings.issue: Browser-provided photo paths previously passed without uploaded objects; source now requires server-only receipt. No production verifier exists yet.
findings.recommendation: Approve and independently verify private image-verification service before deploying these rules.

findings.issue: IAM/Admin SDK writers can bypass Firestore and Storage Rules, including object modification after receipt issuance.
findings.recommendation: Restrict and audit privileged writers; bind real verifier receipts to immutable object generations.

findings.issue: An active courier can create abandoned immutable upload prefixes; lifecycle, per-user quota and retention are not approved.
findings.recommendation: Approve session-bound upload allocation, rate limits and a recoverable retention/cleanup policy before live use.

findings.issue: Synthetic emulators cannot prove iPhone/Android camera, real HEIC decoding, PWA installation or live mobile network behavior.
findings.recommendation: Complete physical-device and real staging tests after cost and access approvals.
